key_highlights: RBA governor signals further rate hikes needed to cool job market; ASX treads water amid rate fears (#33, #65, #71)
Tech stocks lead ASX higher on Wall Street AI rally, but oil snaps losing run on Saudi pipeline restart (#35)
Australian fuel prices surge on global diesel shortage from Iran/Ukraine conflicts, expected to persist into 2027 (#39, #54)
Iron ore downside risk persists, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX (#69)
Gold and silver hit highs; Chinese gold imports set record, supporting ASX miners (#1, #8, #38, #41)
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' mode; Home Depot flags frozen US housing as global signal (#70, #6)
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving baggage/seat fees (#22, #31)
Federal/state governments face debt cliff; Intergenerational Report locks in mass migration (#47, #56)
China cracks widen under Xi; rebalancing towards robots signals structural shift for commodity demand (#57, #48)

sectors.trend: Mixed: gold/silver strength offsets iron ore weakness. Platina, Dalaroo, Advance, Broken Hill, Larvotto show active exploration momentum. Iron ore downside remains a structural headwind.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (WMC.AX, NZG.AX, REG.AX) and silver plays benefit from record Chinese imports. Iron ore majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face margin pressure. Rare earths (Dalaroo) gain from China robot rebalancing.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish pivot pressures bank net interest margins but supports asset quality. Housing 'bloodbath' in Sydney raises NPL concerns. Fiscal debt cliff adds sovereign risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression from rate volatility. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by higher discount rates. Super Retail (SRE.AX) under corporate investigation.

sectors.trend: Saudi pipeline restart and Democrat sweep expectations dump energy prices, but global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) supports Australian fuel prices. Net: volatile, structurally tight diesel.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from diesel scarcity. Downstream refiners face input cost pressure. Airlines (QAN.AX, JPA.AX) hit by $1B Q4 fuel cost surge.

sectors.trend: AI trade powers global and ASX tech rally. Jetstar industrial action disrupts consumer travel. Adelaide CBD foot traffic decline signals consumer softness.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SOL.AX) benefit from AI momentum. JPA.AX faces operational disruption. WES.AX, IAG.AX face consumer spending headwinds.

sectors.trend: Stable; no major ASX-specific headlines. Roivant (ROIV) commercialisation test is US-listed but relevant to CSL.AX competitive landscape.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) remain defensive anchors. No immediate catalyst.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly negative. RBA hawkish signals and rate fears cap upside despite tech/AI rally. Fuel price surge pressures consumer and transport names. Gold miners provide relative strength. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and US-China talks.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from iron ore demand shift, housing correction, and fiscal debt accumulation. Gold/silver and rare earths offer thematic upside. AI/tech remains a growth vector but valuations stretched. El Nino and diesel shortage add 12-month volatility. Net: cautious, selective allocation favoured.
